title: Template kit: ?page= and ?paged= result pages are pagination links, and a rebuild keeps fullShotOf, and a step link finds the opened page's title when the page is read as sections
steps: S1: Run fixedLinkLabels on a kit whose listing page has a link "2" to /donations?page=2 or /news?paged=2 (the result page is also a kit page).
S2: Run keepFullShots on a rebuilt kit with the previous kit's pages naming fullShotOf.

S3: Run relabelKit on a kit whose block has a link "Previous article: Development Prev" to /development, with a content map whose slot pages.development.title belongs to the entity block-development-body (a page read as sections).
S4: Run fixedLinkLabels on kits whose link "2" opens /info?page=about, /news?start=abc, or, on a kit with real pages / and /page/2/, a block shown only on /page/2/ linking to /page/3/.
S5: Run keepFullShots on a rebuilt kit that no longer holds page a, with the previous page b pointing at a.
expect: S1: the link carries the fixed label rule "pagination" (no link-label error).
S2: each rebuilt page has the previous page's fullShotOf.
S3: the link's labelId is pages.development.title.
S4: the link carries no pagination rule.
S5: page b has no fullShotOf.
evidence: JA Impact: the pagination link 2 on Donations and Events was reported as a link-label error; JA Morgan: a rebuild lost fullShotOf; JA Nova: with emdash-sections.json, relabel left 28 Prev/Next links without a label (658 named, 686 without the file)
fence: Pure functions of the kit tool read on made-up kits
